journey.title: Opt out of reminders with the keyboard after choosing Text message
journey.goal: Arrowing from Text message to the opt-out answer hides the mobile number field that no longer applies

functionalJourney.title: Switch reminder channel with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Choosing Email then Text message shows only the mobile number field

guards.title: Choose Email with the keyboard and enter an address
guards.goal: Selecting Email reveals the email address field and the address is kept

plan.root_cause: The Radios component only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven changes (arrow keys).
plan.repair_strategy: Add a change event listener that invokes the same update logic as the click handler, ensuring ARIA attributes and visibility are updated for all radios when selection changes via any interaction.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation will now correctly show/hide conditional fields when selecting different radio options, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate updates when both click and change fire for mouse interactions (idempotent).
Possible interference with other custom change handlers if present.
verification_requirements: Verify arrow key navigation between radios correctly hides/shows associated conditionals.
Verify mouse click selection continues to work as before.
Verify form data reflects the selected radio value.
Verify ARIA attributes aria-expanded and visibility of conditional elements update appropriately.

plan.root_cause: The Radios component only listens for click events on its module container, missing keyboard-driven change events when arrowing between radio groups in separate module containers. The click handler only processes radios within its own module, not the full radio group sharing the same name across modules.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a change event listener on the form ancestor to capture cross-module keyboard navigation, and update the handler to query all radios sharing the same name globally, ensuring conditional visibility updates for the entire radio group.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys) between radio options across module boundaries will correctly show/hide associated conditional fields, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Duplicate processing when both click and change events fire for the same interaction (idempotent setAttributes mitigates this).
Form ancestor not found in edge cases (falls back to module-only click handling).
Multiple Radios instances on the same form each attach form change listeners (harmless duplication).
verification_requirements: Verify arrow key navigation from Text message to opt-out hides mobile number field.
Verify arrow key navigation from opt-out to Email shows email field.
Verify mouse click selection continues to work.
Verify form data reflects selected radio value.
Verify ARIA attributes and conditional visibility update appropriately.
